hook: Your oven has a cleaning setting you've never pressed.

steps.say: Pour the water your manual says onto the cold oven floor.
When it's done, let the oven cool.
Then wipe the loosened grease with a soft sponge.

safety.say: Steam burns, and don't add any cleaner to the water.

result.say: The grease just wipes away. No scrubbing.
result.headline: Zero scrubbing
